text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the William H. (Bill) Bolton Arena Board. This report recommends five candidates for appointment to the board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidates to the William H. (Bill) Bolton Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on May 20, 2025, and until successors are appointed: - Craig Cameron - Peter Diaz - Brittney Grundy - Michael Kane - Stephen Longstaff
